'''Ga'p'tashi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]], who worked as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Like many members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Ga'p'tashi originally worked as a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] officer and enforcer for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. However, after he had been in his job for a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he learned that most species were not ruled by the Hutts, unlike he had been led to believe, so he became angry and left his masters. Ga'p'tashi considered joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but was approached by a member of the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], who wanted Ga'p'tashi to work as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] and harass Hutt shipping. Ga'p'tashi agreed and the Syndicate assisted him in obtaining an [[Imperial Customs Frigate]], which he named the ''[[Nikto Kajidic]]'' and acquired a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] crew for.

After disrupting a number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations, Ga'p'tashi paid off the debt for his ship and launch an attack on ships in the Hutt-controlled [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]]. He built up some profits and planned to invest them in buying a second ship and wanted to eventually assemble a small fleet. However, the Hutts reacted to his activities by placing a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 200,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on his head.
